# Government Relations

The City of Lakewood consistently works to create and maintain successful relationships with leaders at the local, state, and federal levels to achieve its goals and provide for residents.

Below are the City’s priorities across all levels of government.

Don’t know who your elected officials are? [**Visit our Meet Your Representatives page.**](https://cityoflakewood.us/meet-your-representatives)

[**Federal Priorities**](https://cityoflakewood.us/city-council/government-relations/)

[**State Priorities**](https://cityoflakewood.us/city-council/government-relations/)

[**County Priorities**](https://cityoflakewood.us/city-council/government-relations/)

[**SSHA3P** **Priorities**](https://cityoflakewood.us/city-council/government-relations/)

[**SSMCP Priorities**](https://cityoflakewood.us/city-council/government-relations/)

[**2024 Outcomes**](https://cityoflakewood.us/city-council/government-relations/)

* * *

## 2025 Federal Legislative Priorities

- JBLM – McChord Field Clear Zone
- Defense Community Infrastructure Program (DCIP)
- Transportation and Infrastructure Program and Funding
- Base Realignment and Closure (BRAC)
- Medium-Sized City Set Aside

[**Read more about the 202**5 **Federal Priorities (PDF)**](https://cityoflakewood.us/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/2025-Federal-Policy-Agenda_Final.pdf)

* * *

## 2025 State Legislative Priorities

- [Community Partnership Program at Western State Hospital](https://cityoflakewood.us/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/2025-Community-Partnership-Program-One-Pager_Final.pdf)
- [Edgewater Park Improvement Project (28th Legislative District)](https://cityoflakewood.us/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/2025-Edgewater-Park-Improvement-Project-Complete-Packet_Final.pdf)
- [Communication Notification Board (29th Legislative District)](https://cityoflakewood.us/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/2025-Community-Notification-Board-One-Pager_Final.pdf)
- [Clean Buildings Standards Compliance](https://cityoflakewood.us/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/2025-Clean-Buildings-One-Pager_Final.pdf)
- [State Legislative Policy Agenda (One-Page Summary)](https://cityoflakewood.us/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/2025-State-Legislative-Agenda_Final-.pdf)

[**Read the City’s 202**5 **State Legislative Policy Manual (PDF)**](https://cityoflakewood.us/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/2025-State-Legislative-Policy-Manual_Final.pdf)

* * *

## 2025 Pierce County Legislative Priorities

- Promoting middle housing development like accessory dwelling units by addressing sewer fees
- Allocation of Opioid settlement funds.
- Identifying ways to respond to the rise in juvenile crime.
- Support for the partnership with the Pierce County Library System to address the urgent need of permanent and safe library spaces in Lakewood, to include an Interim green space at the current location of the main Lakewood library.

[**Read the City’s 202**5 **Pierce County Policy Manual** (PDF)](https://cityoflakewood.us/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/2025-Pierce-County-Policy-Manual_Final.pdf)

* * *

## 2024 South Sound Housing Affordability Partners Legislative Priorities

The South Sound Housing Affordability Partners (SSHA3P) is a voluntary collaboration among 14 governments to create and preserve affordable, attainable, and accessible housing throughout Pierce County. [**Learn more about SSHA3P here.**](https://southsoundaffordablehousing.org)

**SSHA3P Legislative Priorities:**

- Support basic infrastructure funding via flexible funds through programs like the Public Works Assistance Account (PWAA) and Connecting Housing to Infrastructure Program (CHIP) to help cities and towns fund basic infrastructure, critical to the development of housing.
- Monitor proposals to increase access to homeownership opportunities, including condominium liability reform and recommendations made by the Homeownership Disparity Workgroup.
- Oppose preemption of local land use authority.

[**Click here to see 2024 SSHA3P Legislative Priorities (PDF)**](https://cityoflakewood.us/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/2024-SSHA3P-State-Legislative-Priorities.pdf)

* * *

## 2024 South Sound Military &amp; Communities Partnership (SSMCP) Legislative Agenda

The City of Lakewood is a proud member and leader of the South Sound Military &amp; Communities Partnership (SSMCP). Learn more about the role of Lakewood and SSMCP in the region [here](https://cityoflakewood.us/south-sound-military-and-communities-partnership).

**SSMCP Legislative Priorities Include:**

- I-5 Mounts Road to Tumwater&amp; Nisqually River Delta investment project
- Defense Community Compatibility Account improvements
- Occupational Licensing improvements
- Statewide Economic Impact Analysis

* * *

## 2024 Legislative Outcomes

### 2024 Federal Priorities

**Federal Priorities Include:**

- Bringing federal funding to Lakewood’s top infrastructure priorities (“Green Street Loop” portion of the Downtown Subarea Plan) [Read More (PDF)](https://cityoflakewood.us/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Lakewood-2024-RAISE-Planning-Grant-One-Pager.pdf) **(Achieved)**
- JBLM – McChord Field Clear Zone
- Defense Community Infrastructure Program (DCIP)
- Transportation and Infrastructure Program and Funding
- Base Realignment and Closure (BRAC)
- Medium-Sized City Set Aside

[**City’s 202**4 **Federal Priorities (PDF)**](https://cityoflakewood.us/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Final-2024-Federal-Policy-Agenda.pdf)

### 2024 State Priorities

**2024 state legislative priorities:**

- [Continued refinement and updates to new public safety laws (PDF)](https://cityoflakewood.us/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Final-2024-Public-Safety-Four-Pager.pdf)
- [Geographic equity in the discharge of people from state-run facilities (PDF)](https://cityoflakewood.us/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Final-2024-Geographic-Equity-in-Discharge-One-Pager.pdf)
- [One-page overview of the City of Lakewood’s state legislative priorities (PDF)](https://cityoflakewood.us/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Final-2024-State-Legislative-Agenda-One-Pager.pdf)

[**Read the City’s 202**4 **State Legislative Policy Manual (PDF)**](https://cityoflakewood.us/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Final-2024-State-Legislative-Policy-Manual.pdf)

### 2024 SSMCP Legislative Agenda

- I-5 Mounts Road to Tumwater&amp; Nisqually River Delta investment project
- Defense Community Compatibility Account improvements
- Occupational Licensing improvements
- Statewide Economic Impact Analysis

### 2024 Pierce County Legislative Priorities

**2023 Pierce County Legislative Priorities:**

- Promoting middle housing development like accessory dwelling units by addressing sewer fees
- Allocation of Opioid settlement funds.
- Identifying ways to respond to the rise in juvenile crime.
- Support for the partnership with the Pierce County Library System to address the urgent need of permanent and safe library spaces in Lakewood.

[**Read the City’s 2023 Pierce County Policy Manual (PDF)**](https://cityoflakewood.us/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/FINAL-DRAFT-2023-Pierce-County-Policy-Manual-.pdf)
